91	        uses: taiki-e/install-action@1168f6810a3cb30a3514bf5756a3b7f0422c6df8 # v2
92	        with:
93	          tool: just@1.58.0
94	      - name: Verify release workflow contracts
95	        run: just release-workflow-checks
96	
97	  release-candidate:
98	    name: Identify a merged Callisto release PR
99	    needs: [verify, recovery-checks]
100	    # Exactly one gate runs per event; a failed gate matches neither clause.
101	    if: >-
102	      always() && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
103	      ((needs.verify.result == 'success' && needs.recovery-checks.result == 'skipped') ||
104	       (needs.recovery-checks.result == 'success' && needs.verify.result == 'skipped'))
105	    timeout-minutes: 10
106	    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
107	    permissions:
108	      contents: read
109	      pull-requests: read
110	    outputs:
111	      is_release_pr: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.is_release_pr }}
112	      release_source_sha: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
113	      orchestration_sha: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
114	    steps:
115	      - id: candidate
116	        shell: bash
117	        env:
118	          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
119	          RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA_INPUT: ${{ inputs.release_source_sha }}
120	          TRIGGERING_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
121	        run: |
122	          set -euo pipefail
123	          release_source_sha="${RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA_INPUT:-$TRIGGERING_SHA}"
124	          if [[ ! "$release_source_sha" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]; then
125	            echo "::error::release_source_sha must be exactly 40 lowercase hex characters"
126	            exit 1
127	          fi
128	          resolved_sha=$(gh api "/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${release_source_sha}" --jq '.sha')
129	          if [[ "$resolved_sha" != "$release_source_sha" ]]; then
130	            echo "::error::release_source_sha does not resolve to that exact commit"
131	            exit 1
132	          fi
133	          # Attestations are stamped with this run's own SHA, so the
134	          # coordinator must be exactly the revision running this workflow.
135	          orchestration_sha="$TRIGGERING_SHA"
136	          # This only schedules the job. `release plan` verifies the actual
137	          # parent-to-merge delta; labels and PR metadata are never authority.
138	          # The GitHub API check is complementary provenance evidence: a
139	          # trusted merge must be both an actual merge of the managed PR and
140	          # a GitHub-verified signed commit. It cannot be a direct push.
141	          prs=$(gh api --paginate "/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${release_source_sha}/pulls" --jq '[.[] | select(.merged_at != null and .base.ref == "main" and .head.repo.full_name == "'"${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}"'" and (.head.ref == "callisto/version-packages" or (.head.ref | test("^callisto/version-packages--[0-9a-f]{40}$"))))] | length')
142	          verified=$(gh api "/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${release_source_sha}" --jq '.commit.verification.verified')
143	          if [[ "$prs" == 1 && "$verified" == true ]]; then
144	            {
145	              echo 'is_release_pr=true'
146	              echo "release_source_sha=$release_source_sha"
147	              echo "orchestration_sha=$orchestration_sha"
148	            } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
149	          else
150	            echo 'is_release_pr=false' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
151	          fi
152	
153	  version-pr:
154	    name: Create or update the Callisto release PR
155	    needs: release-candidate
156	    if: >-
157	      always() && needs.release-candidate.result == 'success' &&
158	      needs.release-candidate.outputs.is_release_pr != 'true' &&
159	      inputs.release_source_sha == ''
160	    timeout-minutes: 10
161	    concurrency:
162	      group: version-pr
163	      cancel-in-progress: false
164	    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
165	    permissions:
166	      contents: write
167	      pull-requests: write
168	    outputs:
169	      has_pending_changesets: ${{ steps.version-pr.outputs.hasChangesets }}
170	
171	    steps:
172	      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
173	        with:
174	          fetch-depth: 0
175	          persist-credentials: false
176	      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
177	        with:
178	          source: local
179	      - name: Compose, version, and open the release PR
180	        id: version-pr
181	        uses: $/.github/actions/callisto-action
182	        with:
183	          setup_callisto: 'false'
184	          branch: main
185	          release_branch: callisto/version-packages
186	          # Interdependent Cargo packages bump together, so Cargo.lock must be refreshed in the release PR.
187	          version_command: 'callisto version --refresh-lockfiles'
188	        env:
189	          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
190	
191	  plan:
192	    name: Derive ephemeral intent from the merged release commit
193	    needs: release-candidate
194	    # always(): release-candidate's own ancestors include a gate that is skipped
195	    # by design, and a skipped ancestor silently skips any job without a status function.
196	    if: >-
197	      always() && needs.release-candidate.result == 'success' &&
198	      needs.release-candidate.outputs.is_release_pr == 'true'
199	    timeout-minutes: 20
200	    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
201	    permissions:
202	      contents: read
203	    outputs:
204	      has_artifacts: ${{ steps.slots.outputs.has_artifacts }}
205	    steps:
206	      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
207	        with:
208	          # The coordinator must be the current workflow revision. Recovery
209	          # never rebuilds its release engine from historic source.
210	          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
211	          fetch-depth: 0
212	          persist-credentials: false
213	      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
214	        with:
215	          source: local
216	      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
217	        with:
218	          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
219	          path: release-source
220	          fetch-depth: 0
221	          persist-credentials: false
222	      - name: Derive and hash intent
223	        env:
224	          RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
225	          ORCHESTRATION_SHA: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
226	        run: |
227	          set -euo pipefail
228	          handoff_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent"
229	          mkdir -p "$handoff_dir"
230	          callisto release plan --source-root "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/release-source" \
231	            --orchestration-revision "$ORCHESTRATION_SHA" --artifact-repository "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
232	            --from-release-commit "$RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA" \
233	            --decision "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/release-source/.callisto/release-decision.json" \
234	            --out "$handoff_dir/release-intent.json"
235	          # Relative name: the consumers verify from a different runner OS and RUNNER_TEMP.
236	          (cd "$handoff_dir" && shasum -a 256 release-intent.json > release-intent.json.sha256)
237	      - name: Read declared artifact slot count
238	        id: slots
239	        run: |
240	          set -euo pipefail
241	          # Own statement: set -e cannot see a substitution failing inside an echo argument.
242	          has_artifacts=$(jq '.artifactSlots | length > 0' "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent/release-intent.json")
243	          case "$has_artifacts" in
244	            true|false) ;;
245	            *) echo "::error::artifact slot probe returned '$has_artifacts'"; exit 1 ;;
246	          esac
247	          echo "has_artifacts=$has_artifacts" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
248	      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
249	        with:
250	          name: release-intent
251	          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
252	          if-no-files-found: error
253	          # 1 day was too short: a stuck run needing "execute" re-run days
254	          # later (e.g. while a workflow bug gets diagnosed and fixed) loses
255	          # this artifact before the fix even lands, forcing a full rerun
256	          # instead of just the failed job.
257	          retention-days: 7

259	  build-artifact:
260	    name: Build ${{ matrix.target }} from the intent-bound source tree
261	    needs: [plan, release-candidate]
262	    if: always() && needs.plan.result == 'success' && needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts == 'true'
263	    timeout-minutes: 45
264	    strategy:
265	      fail-fast: false
266	      matrix:
267	        include:
268	          - id: macos-arm64
269	            runner: macos-14
270	            target: aarch64-apple-darwin
271	            asset: callisto-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz
272	            kind: cli
273	          - id: macos-x64
274	            runner: macos-14
275	            target: x86_64-apple-darwin
276	            asset: callisto-x86_64-apple-darwin.tar.gz
277	            kind: cli
278	          - id: linux-gnu
279	            runner: ubuntu-latest
280	            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
281	            asset: callisto-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz
282	            kind: cli
283	          - id: linux-arm64
284	            runner: ubuntu-24.04-arm
285	            target: aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
286	            asset: callisto-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz
287	            kind: cli
288	          - id: linux-musl
289	            runner: ubuntu-latest
290	            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-musl
291	            asset: callisto-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz
292	            kind: cross
293	    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
294	    permissions:
295	      contents: read
296	      attestations: write
297	      id-token: write
298	    steps:
299	      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
300	        with:
301	          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
302	          fetch-depth: 0
303	          persist-credentials: false
304	      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
305	        with:
306	          source: local
307	      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
308	        with:
309	          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
310	          path: release-source
311	          fetch-depth: 0
312	          persist-credentials: false
313	      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
314	        with:
315	          name: release-intent
316	          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent

318	        run: |
319	          set -euo pipefail
320	          handoff_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent"
321	          (cd "$handoff_dir" && shasum -a 256 -c release-intent.json.sha256)
322	          callisto release inspect --input "$handoff_dir/release-intent.json"
323	          mkdir -p "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-artifacts"
324	      - name: Build declared artifact
325	        env:
326	          CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_KIND: ${{ matrix.kind }}
327	          CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_TARGET: ${{ matrix.target }}
328	          CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_ASSET: ${{ matrix.asset }}
329	          CALLISTO_RELEASE_SOURCE_ROOT: ${{ github.workspace }}/release-source
330	          CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-artifacts
331	        run: |
332	          bash .github/scripts/build-release-artifact.sh
333	      - name: Attest exact artifact bytes
334	        uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@4d101475d8b20a2381f78447822ac1eab6504dd8 # v4.2.2
335	        with:
336	          subject-path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-artifacts/${{ matrix.asset }}
337	      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
338	        with:
339	          name: release-build-${{ matrix.id }}
340	          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-artifacts/${{ matrix.asset }}
341	          if-no-files-found: error
342	          # 1 day was too short: a stuck run needing "execute" re-run days
343	          # later (e.g. while a workflow bug gets diagnosed and fixed) loses
344	          # this artifact before the fix even lands, forcing a full rerun
345	          # instead of just the failed job.
346	          retention-days: 7
347	
348	  build:
349	    name: Assemble attested product artifacts
350	    needs: [build-artifact, release-candidate, plan]
351	    if: always() && needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts == 'true' && needs.build-artifact.result == 'success'
352	    timeout-minutes: 15
353	    outputs:
354	      orchestration_sha: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
355	      release_source_sha: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
356	    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
357	    permissions:
358	      contents: read
359	    steps:
360	      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
361	        with:
362	          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
363	          fetch-depth: 0
364	          persist-credentials: false
365	      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
366	        with:
367	          source: local
368	      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
369	        with:
370	          name: release-intent
371	          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
372	      # Every matrix target's artifact, so a target added to the matrix cannot be built and then left out of the manifest.
373	      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
374	        with:
375	          pattern: release-build-*
376	          merge-multiple: true
377	          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-artifacts
378	      - name: Create exact artifact manifest
379	        run: |
380	          set -euo pipefail
381	          callisto release artifact-manifest --intent "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent/release-intent.json" --artifact-dir "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-artifacts" --out "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-artifacts/manifest.json"
382	      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
383	        with:
384	          name: release-build
385	          path: |
386	            ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
387	            ${{ runner.temp }}/release-artifacts
388	          if-no-files-found: error
389	          retention-days: 7
390	
391	  execute:
392	    name: Execute approved release
393	    needs: [plan, build, release-candidate]
394	    # Artifact-less sources skip build; a failed or cancelled build must still block.
395	    # !cancelled() not always(): a status function still defeats the skipped-ancestor
396	    # rule, but cancelling the run must stop the one irreversible job.
397	    if: >-
398	      !cancelled() && needs.plan.result == 'success' &&
399	      (needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts == 'false' || needs.build.result == 'success')
400	    timeout-minutes: 60
401	    concurrency:
402	      group: release-execute
403	      cancel-in-progress: false
404	    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
405	    permissions:
406	      contents: write
407	      attestations: read
408	    steps:
409	      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
410	        with:
411	          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
412	          fetch-depth: 0
413	          persist-credentials: false
414	      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
415	        with:
416	          source: local
417	      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
418	        with:
419	          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
420	          path: release-source
421	          fetch-depth: 0
422	          # The release-source checkout alone needs Git credentials because
423	          # graph-owned tag dispatch pushes from this repository.
424	          persist-credentials: true
425	      # Downloaded outside the workspace (under $RUNNER_TEMP, like
426	      # setup-callisto's own binary install): callisto release execute
427	      # re-checks release trust before every dispatch, which requires a
428	      # worktree with no tracked or untracked files -- landing these inside
429	      # the checkout would dirty it and fail that check before anything
430	      # gets published.
431	      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
432	        with:
433	          name: release-intent
434	          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
435	      - if: needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts == 'true'
436	        uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
437	        with:
438	          name: release-build
439	          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-build
440	      - name: Verify same-run handoff before credentials
441	        env:
442	          HAS_ARTIFACTS: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts }}
443	        run: |
444	          set -euo pipefail
445	          intent_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent"
446	          build_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-build"
447	          (cd "$intent_dir" && shasum -a 256 -c release-intent.json.sha256)
448	          if [[ "$HAS_ARTIFACTS" == true ]]; then
449	            cmp "$intent_dir/release-intent.json" "$build_dir/release-intent/release-intent.json"
450	          fi
451	      - name: Execute verified release
452	        env:
453	          CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN }}
454	          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
455	          ORCHESTRATION_SHA: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
456	        run: |
457	          set -euo pipefail
458	          intent_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent"
459	          build_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-build"
460	          receipt_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto-release-receipt/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"
461	          mkdir -p "$receipt_dir"
462	          args=(--source-root "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/release-source" --intent "$intent_dir/release-intent.json" --receipt "$receipt_dir/release-receipt.json" --orchestration-revision "$ORCHESTRATION_SHA")
463	          if [[ -f "$build_dir/release-artifacts/manifest.json" ]]; then
464	            args+=(--artifact-manifest "$build_dir/release-artifacts/manifest.json" --artifact-dir "$build_dir/release-artifacts")
465	          fi
466	          callisto release execute "${args[@]}"
467	      # Needs no secrets: a plain tag push with the checkout's Git credentials, like the release tags. A no-op before 1.0.0.
468	      - name: Move the floating major tag
469	        working-directory: release-source
470	        env:
471	          RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
472	        run: bash "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.github/scripts/move-floating-tag.sh" .callisto/release-decision.json cargo/callisto-cli "$RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA"
473	      - name: Summarize receipt
474	        if: always()
475	        run: |
476	          receipt="${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto-release-receipt/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}/release-receipt.json"
477	          if [[ -f "$receipt" ]]; then
478	            {
479	              echo '### Release receipt'
480	              echo '```json'
481	              cat "$receipt"
482	              echo '```'
483	            } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
484	          fi
485	      - name: Upload receipt
486	        if: always()
487	        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
488	        with:
489	          # Per attempt: keeps each attempt's receipt instead of shadowing the prior one.
490	          name: release-receipt-attempt-${{ github.run_attempt }}
491	          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/callisto-release-receipt/${{ github.run_id }}
492	          if-no-files-found: ignore
493	          retention-days: 7

file.content:
name: Release

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      release_source_sha:
        description: 'Merged managed release-PR commit to recover; leave empty for the triggering commit.'
        required: false
        type: string

permissions: {}

# One group per commit: GitHub replaces a pending run in a shared group, which
# could silently drop a release merge queued behind an unrelated push.
concurrency:
  group: release-${{ github.sha }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  verify:
    name: Verify release candidate
    if: github.event_name == 'push' || inputs.release_source_sha == ''
    timeout-minutes: 45
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Build local Callisto
        uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
        with:
          source: local

      - name: Install just
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@1168f6810a3cb30a3514bf5756a3b7f0422c6df8 # v2
        with:
          tool: just@1.58.0

      - name: Format Check
        run: just fmt-check

      - name: Clippy Lints
        run: just lint

      - name: Install release verification tools
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@1168f6810a3cb30a3514bf5756a3b7f0422c6df8 # v2
        with:
          tool: cargo-nextest,ripgrep

      - name: Install registry test tools
        uses: $/.github/actions/install-registry-test-tools

      - name: Unit & Integration Tests
        run: just test

      - name: Install cargo-deny
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@1168f6810a3cb30a3514bf5756a3b7f0422c6df8 # v2
        with:
          tool: cargo-deny

      - name: Supply Chain Audit
        run: just audit

      - name: Verify workflow contracts and reject mutable action references
        run: just workflow-contracts

  recovery-checks:
    name: Check release workflow policy for recovery
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.release_source_sha != ''
    timeout-minutes: 10
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install ripgrep
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@1168f6810a3cb30a3514bf5756a3b7f0422c6df8 # v2
        with:
          tool: ripgrep
      - name: Install just
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@1168f6810a3cb30a3514bf5756a3b7f0422c6df8 # v2
        with:
          tool: just@1.58.0
      - name: Verify release workflow contracts
        run: just release-workflow-checks

  release-candidate:
    name: Identify a merged Callisto release PR
    needs: [verify, recovery-checks]
    # Exactly one gate runs per event; a failed gate matches neither clause.
    if: >-
      always() && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
      ((needs.verify.result == 'success' && needs.recovery-checks.result == 'skipped') ||
       (needs.recovery-checks.result == 'success' && needs.verify.result == 'skipped'))
    timeout-minutes: 10
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      is_release_pr: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.is_release_pr }}
      release_source_sha: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
      orchestration_sha: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
    steps:
      - id: candidate
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA_INPUT: ${{ inputs.release_source_sha }}
          TRIGGERING_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          release_source_sha="${RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA_INPUT:-$TRIGGERING_SHA}"
          if [[ ! "$release_source_sha" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]; then
            echo "::error::release_source_sha must be exactly 40 lowercase hex characters"
            exit 1
          fi
          resolved_sha=$(gh api "/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${release_source_sha}" --jq '.sha')
          if [[ "$resolved_sha" != "$release_source_sha" ]]; then
            echo "::error::release_source_sha does not resolve to that exact commit"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Attestations are stamped with this run's own SHA, so the
          # coordinator must be exactly the revision running this workflow.
          orchestration_sha="$TRIGGERING_SHA"
          # This only schedules the job. `release plan` verifies the actual
          # parent-to-merge delta; labels and PR metadata are never authority.
          # The GitHub API check is complementary provenance evidence: a
          # trusted merge must be both an actual merge of the managed PR and
          # a GitHub-verified signed commit. It cannot be a direct push.
          prs=$(gh api --paginate "/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${release_source_sha}/pulls" --jq '[.[] | select(.merged_at != null and .base.ref == "main" and .head.repo.full_name == "'"${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}"'" and (.head.ref == "callisto/version-packages" or (.head.ref | test("^callisto/version-packages--[0-9a-f]{40}$"))))] | length')
          verified=$(gh api "/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${release_source_sha}" --jq '.commit.verification.verified')
          if [[ "$prs" == 1 && "$verified" == true ]]; then
            {
              echo 'is_release_pr=true'
              echo "release_source_sha=$release_source_sha"
              echo "orchestration_sha=$orchestration_sha"
            } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo 'is_release_pr=false' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

  version-pr:
    name: Create or update the Callisto release PR
    needs: release-candidate
    if: >-
      always() && needs.release-candidate.result == 'success' &&
      needs.release-candidate.outputs.is_release_pr != 'true' &&
      inputs.release_source_sha == ''
    timeout-minutes: 10
    concurrency:
      group: version-pr
      cancel-in-progress: false
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    outputs:
      has_pending_changesets: ${{ steps.version-pr.outputs.hasChangesets }}

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
        with:
          source: local
      - name: Compose, version, and open the release PR
        id: version-pr
        uses: $/.github/actions/callisto-action
        with:
          setup_callisto: 'false'
          branch: main
          release_branch: callisto/version-packages
          # Interdependent Cargo packages bump together, so Cargo.lock must be refreshed in the release PR.
          version_command: 'callisto version --refresh-lockfiles'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}

  plan:
    name: Derive ephemeral intent from the merged release commit
    needs: release-candidate
    # always(): release-candidate's own ancestors include a gate that is skipped
    # by design, and a skipped ancestor silently skips any job without a status function.
    if: >-
      always() && needs.release-candidate.result == 'success' &&
      needs.release-candidate.outputs.is_release_pr == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 20
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      has_artifacts: ${{ steps.slots.outputs.has_artifacts }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          # The coordinator must be the current workflow revision. Recovery
          # never rebuilds its release engine from historic source.
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
        with:
          source: local
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          path: release-source
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Derive and hash intent
        env:
          RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          ORCHESTRATION_SHA: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          handoff_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent"
          mkdir -p "$handoff_dir"
          callisto release plan --source-root "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/release-source" \
            --orchestration-revision "$ORCHESTRATION_SHA" --artifact-repository "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
            --from-release-commit "$RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA" \
            --decision "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/release-source/.callisto/release-decision.json" \
            --out "$handoff_dir/release-intent.json"
          # Relative name: the consumers verify from a different runner OS and RUNNER_TEMP.
          (cd "$handoff_dir" && shasum -a 256 release-intent.json > release-intent.json.sha256)
      - name: Read declared artifact slot count
        id: slots
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Own statement: set -e cannot see a substitution failing inside an echo argument.
          has_artifacts=$(jq '.artifactSlots | length > 0' "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent/release-intent.json")
          case "$has_artifacts" in
            true|false) ;;
            *) echo "::error::artifact slot probe returned '$has_artifacts'"; exit 1 ;;
          esac
          echo "has_artifacts=$has_artifacts" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: release-intent
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
          if-no-files-found: error
          # 1 day was too short: a stuck run needing "execute" re-run days
          # later (e.g. while a workflow bug gets diagnosed and fixed) loses
          # this artifact before the fix even lands, forcing a full rerun
          # instead of just the failed job.
          retention-days: 7

  build-artifact:
    name: Build ${{ matrix.target }} from the intent-bound source tree
    needs: [plan, release-candidate]
    if: always() && needs.plan.result == 'success' && needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 45
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - id: macos-arm64
            runner: macos-14
            target: aarch64-apple-darwin
            asset: callisto-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz
            kind: cli
          - id: macos-x64
            runner: macos-14
            target: x86_64-apple-darwin
            asset: callisto-x86_64-apple-darwin.tar.gz
            kind: cli
          - id: linux-gnu
            runner: ubuntu-latest
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            asset: callisto-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz
            kind: cli
          - id: linux-arm64
            runner: ubuntu-24.04-arm
            target: aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
            asset: callisto-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz
            kind: cli
          - id: linux-musl
            runner: ubuntu-latest
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-musl
            asset: callisto-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz
            kind: cross
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      attestations: write
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
        with:
          source: local
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          path: release-source
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: release-intent
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
      - name: Verify handoff
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          handoff_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent"
          (cd "$handoff_dir" && shasum -a 256 -c release-intent.json.sha256)
          callisto release inspect --input "$handoff_dir/release-intent.json"
          mkdir -p "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-artifacts"
      - name: Build declared artifact
        env:
          CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_KIND: ${{ matrix.kind }}
          CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_TARGET: ${{ matrix.target }}
          CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_ASSET: ${{ matrix.asset }}
          CALLISTO_RELEASE_SOURCE_ROOT: ${{ github.workspace }}/release-source
          CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-artifacts
        run: |
          bash .github/scripts/build-release-artifact.sh
      - name: Attest exact artifact bytes
        uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@4d101475d8b20a2381f78447822ac1eab6504dd8 # v4.2.2
        with:
          subject-path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-artifacts/${{ matrix.asset }}
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: release-build-${{ matrix.id }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-artifacts/${{ matrix.asset }}
          if-no-files-found: error
          # 1 day was too short: a stuck run needing "execute" re-run days
          # later (e.g. while a workflow bug gets diagnosed and fixed) loses
          # this artifact before the fix even lands, forcing a full rerun
          # instead of just the failed job.
          retention-days: 7

  build:
    name: Assemble attested product artifacts
    needs: [build-artifact, release-candidate, plan]
    if: always() && needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts == 'true' && needs.build-artifact.result == 'success'
    timeout-minutes: 15
    outputs:
      orchestration_sha: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
      release_source_sha: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
        with:
          source: local
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: release-intent
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
      # Every matrix target's artifact, so a target added to the matrix cannot be built and then left out of the manifest.
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          pattern: release-build-*
          merge-multiple: true
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-artifacts
      - name: Create exact artifact manifest
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          callisto release artifact-manifest --intent "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent/release-intent.json" --artifact-dir "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-artifacts" --out "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-artifacts/manifest.json"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: release-build
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
            ${{ runner.temp }}/release-artifacts
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

  execute:
    name: Execute approved release
    needs: [plan, build, release-candidate]
    # Artifact-less sources skip build; a failed or cancelled build must still block.
    # !cancelled() not always(): a status function still defeats the skipped-ancestor
    # rule, but cancelling the run must stop the one irreversible job.
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.plan.result == 'success' &&
      (needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts == 'false' || needs.build.result == 'success')
    timeout-minutes: 60
    concurrency:
      group: release-execute
      cancel-in-progress: false
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      attestations: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
        with:
          source: local
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          path: release-source
          fetch-depth: 0
          # The release-source checkout alone needs Git credentials because
          # graph-owned tag dispatch pushes from this repository.
          persist-credentials: true
      # Downloaded outside the workspace (under $RUNNER_TEMP, like
      # setup-callisto's own binary install): callisto release execute
      # re-checks release trust before every dispatch, which requires a
      # worktree with no tracked or untracked files -- landing these inside
      # the checkout would dirty it and fail that check before anything
      # gets published.
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: release-intent
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
      - if: needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts == 'true'
        uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: release-build
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-build
      - name: Verify same-run handoff before credentials
        env:
          HAS_ARTIFACTS: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          intent_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent"
          build_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-build"
          (cd "$intent_dir" && shasum -a 256 -c release-intent.json.sha256)
          if [[ "$HAS_ARTIFACTS" == true ]]; then
            cmp "$intent_dir/release-intent.json" "$build_dir/release-intent/release-intent.json"
          fi
      - name: Execute verified release
        env:
          CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          ORCHESTRATION_SHA: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          intent_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent"
          build_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-build"
          receipt_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto-release-receipt/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"
          mkdir -p "$receipt_dir"
          args=(--source-root "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/release-source" --intent "$intent_dir/release-intent.json" --receipt "$receipt_dir/release-receipt.json" --orchestration-revision "$ORCHESTRATION_SHA")
          if [[ -f "$build_dir/release-artifacts/manifest.json" ]]; then
            args+=(--artifact-manifest "$build_dir/release-artifacts/manifest.json" --artifact-dir "$build_dir/release-artifacts")
          fi
          callisto release execute "${args[@]}"
      # Needs no secrets: a plain tag push with the checkout's Git credentials, like the release tags. A no-op before 1.0.0.
      - name: Move the floating major tag
        working-directory: release-source
        env:
          RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
        run: bash "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.github/scripts/move-floating-tag.sh" .callisto/release-decision.json cargo/callisto-cli "$RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA"
      - name: Summarize receipt
        if: always()
        run: |
          receipt="${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto-release-receipt/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}/release-receipt.json"
          if [[ -f "$receipt" ]]; then
            {
              echo '### Release receipt'
              echo '```json'
              cat "$receipt"
              echo '```'
            } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          fi
      - name: Upload receipt
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          # Per attempt: keeps each attempt's receipt instead of shadowing the prior one.
          name: release-receipt-attempt-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/callisto-release-receipt/${{ github.run_id }}
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 7

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Executes a typed Callisto release-PR decision. Forge reads stay here; all
# create/update policy belongs to `callisto release-pr decide`.
#
# The managed branch is never pushed with the Git wire protocol: on a public
# repository, GITHUB_TOKEN cannot write `.github/workflows/*` that way, nor
# through createCommitOnBranch's own fileChanges, on any ref (confirmed
# directly against this repository). Instead, the generated
# version-bump changes are committed via the forge commit API onto a
# deterministic staging branch rooted at the current base commit -- which
# never needs to touch `.github/workflows/*`, since that path is inherited
# unchanged from the base -- and only then is the managed branch's ref moved
# onto that commit. A ref move is not itself a write to that path.
set -euo pipefail

cd "$INPUT_CWD"

# This checkout starts on the configured base. Preserve its exact commit for
# both observations; the working tree changes below (git add -A) never
# create a local commit -- the real commit is made remotely, via the forge
# commit API, on the staging branch.
base_commit=$(git rev-parse HEAD)

release_pr_snapshot() {
  local raw_prs
  raw_prs=$(gh pr list --state open --base "$INPUT_BRANCH" --limit 1000 --json number,headRefName,headRepository,headRefOid)
  jq -cn \
    --arg repository "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
    --arg base_branch "$INPUT_BRANCH" \
    --arg base_commit "$base_commit" \
    --argjson raw_prs "$raw_prs" \
    '{
      schemaVersion: 2,
      repository: $repository,
      baseBranch: $base_branch,
      baseCommit: $base_commit,
      openPullRequests: [$raw_prs[] | {
        number,
        headRepository: (.headRepository.nameWithOwner // ""),
        headBranch: .headRefName,
        headCommit: .headRefOid
      }]
    }'
}

snapshot=$(release_pr_snapshot)
decision=$(callisto --format json release-pr decide \
  --snapshot "$snapshot" \
  --repository "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
  --base-branch "$INPUT_BRANCH" \
  --release-branch "$INPUT_RELEASE_BRANCH")
decision_kind=$(jq -r '.action.kind' <<< "$decision")

case "$decision_kind" in
  noop)
    echo 'hasChangesets=false' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
    echo '::notice::No changesets. This action does not publish, tag, download artifacts, or create releases; use the durable repository workflow.'
    exit 0
    ;;
  create)
    release_branch=$(jq -r '.action.branch' <<< "$decision")
    staging_branch=$(jq -r '.action.stagingBranch' <<< "$decision")
    existing_pr=''
    ;;
  update)
    existing_pr=$(jq -r '.action.pullRequestNumber' <<< "$decision")
    release_branch=$(jq -r '.action.branch' <<< "$decision")
    staging_branch=$(jq -r '.action.stagingBranch' <<< "$decision")
    ;;
  *) echo "::error::Callisto returned unsupported release PR decision kind: $decision_kind"; exit 1 ;;
esac

echo 'hasChangesets=true' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
if [[ -n "$existing_pr" ]]; then
  existing_body=$(gh pr view "$existing_pr" --json body --jq '.body')
  body=$(printf '%s' "$existing_body" | callisto compose-pr-body --existing-body - --branch "$INPUT_BRANCH" --format text)
else
  body=$(callisto compose-pr-body --branch "$INPUT_BRANCH" --format text)
fi

read -ra command <<< "$INPUT_VERSION_COMMAND"
command+=(--emit-decision "$INPUT_DECISION_PATH")
"${command[@]}"
git add -A
test -n "$(git status --porcelain)" || { echo '::error::pending changesets produced no release-PR delta'; exit 1; }

plan_file=$(mktemp)
callisto --format json release-pr commit-plan --base-commit "$base_commit" --message "$INPUT_COMMIT_MESSAGE" --out "$plan_file"
local_tree=$(git write-tree)

staging_created=false
cleanup_staging() {
  if [[ "$staging_created" == true ]]; then
    gh api -X DELETE "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/refs/heads/$staging_branch" > /dev/null 2>&1 \
      || echo "::warning::could not delete staging branch $staging_branch; the next run reclaims this deterministic name"
  fi
  rm -f "$plan_file" body.json
}
trap cleanup_staging EXIT

# A local diff does not authorize a stale forge write. Re-observe immediately
# before mutating the remote branch, then again before moving the managed
# ref, then again before GitHub label/PR writes.
callisto release-pr verify --decision "$decision" --snapshot "$(release_pr_snapshot)" > /dev/null

if gh api -X PATCH "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/refs/heads/$staging_branch" -f sha="$base_commit" -F force=true > /dev/null 2>&1; then
  :
else
  gh api -X POST "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/refs" -f ref="refs/heads/$staging_branch" -f sha="$base_commit" > /dev/null
fi
staging_created=true

jq -n \
  --arg repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
  --arg branch "$staging_branch" \
  --arg headline "$INPUT_COMMIT_MESSAGE" \
  --slurpfile plan "$plan_file" \
  '{
    query: "mutation($input: CreateCommitOnBranchInput!) { createCommitOnBranch(input: $input) { commit { oid } } }",
    variables: {
      input: {
        branch: {repositoryNameWithOwner: $repo, branchName: $branch},
        message: {headline: $headline},
        expectedHeadOid: $plan[0].baseCommit,
        fileChanges: {
          additions: [$plan[0].additions[] | {path, contents: .contentsBase64}],
          deletions: $plan[0].deletions
        }
      }
    }
  }' > body.json

new_sha=$(gh api graphql --input body.json --jq '.data.createCommitOnBranch.commit.oid')
remote_tree=$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/commits/$new_sha" --jq '.tree.sha')
if [[ "$remote_tree" != "$local_tree" ]]; then
  echo "::error::forge commit tree $remote_tree does not match the locally staged tree $local_tree; refusing to move $release_branch"
  exit 1
fi

callisto release-pr verify --decision "$decision" --snapshot "$(release_pr_snapshot)" > /dev/null

if [[ "$decision_kind" == update ]]; then
  gh api -X PATCH "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/refs/heads/$release_branch" -f sha="$new_sha" -F force=true > /dev/null
else
  if ! gh api -X POST "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/refs" -f ref="refs/heads/$release_branch" -f sha="$new_sha" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
    gh api -X PATCH "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/refs/heads/$release_branch" -f sha="$new_sha" -F force=true > /dev/null
  fi
fi
moved_sha=$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/refs/heads/$release_branch" --jq '.object.sha')
if [[ "$moved_sha" != "$new_sha" ]]; then
  echo "::error::$release_branch points at $moved_sha after the update, expected $new_sha; a concurrent write may have raced this run"
  exit 1
fi

if [[ "$decision_kind" == update ]]; then
  # The PR list can lag a ref move by a moment, and a stale read looks like a changed snapshot.
  # A real concurrent change stays visible, so the last attempt still fails.
  verified=false
  for _ in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9; do
    if callisto release-pr verify --decision "$decision" --snapshot "$(release_pr_snapshot)" \
      --applied-head "$new_sha" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
      verified=true
      break
    fi
    sleep 3
  done
  if [[ "$verified" != true ]]; then
    callisto release-pr verify --decision "$decision" --snapshot "$(release_pr_snapshot)" \
      --applied-head "$new_sha" > /dev/null
  fi
else
  callisto release-pr verify --decision "$decision" --snapshot "$(release_pr_snapshot)" > /dev/null
fi

label_exists=$(gh label list --limit 1000 --json name --jq 'any(.[]; .name == env.INPUT_PR_LABEL)')
if [[ "$label_exists" != true ]]; then
  gh label create "$INPUT_PR_LABEL" --color 0e8a16 --description 'Callisto release packages'
fi

case "$decision_kind" in
  create)
    gh pr create --head "$release_branch" --base "$INPUT_BRANCH" --title "$INPUT_TITLE" --body "$body" --label "$INPUT_PR_LABEL"
    ;;
  update)
    gh pr edit "$existing_pr" --title "$INPUT_TITLE" --body "$body" --add-label "$INPUT_PR_LABEL"
    ;;
esac
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Moves the floating major tag (v1, v2, ...) to a release commit, for a stable release at or past 1.0.0.
# Run inside the release-source checkout, after the release succeeded, so `uses: ...@v1` follows the newest 1.x.
# Usage: move-floating-tag.sh <release-decision.json> <package> <commit> [remote]
set -euo pipefail

decision="${1:?usage: move-floating-tag.sh <release-decision.json> <package> <commit> [remote]}"
package="${2:?missing package}"
commit="${3:?missing commit}"
remote="${4:-origin}"

if [[ ! "$commit" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]; then
  echo "::error::commit must be exactly 40 lowercase hex characters"
  exit 1
fi

version=$(jq -r --arg package "$package" '[.entries[] | select(.package == $package) | .targetVersion][0] // empty' "$decision")
if [[ -z "$version" ]]; then
  echo "$package is not in this release; no floating tag to move"
  exit 0
fi
if [[ ! "$version" =~ ^([0-9]+)\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then
  echo "$version is not a stable X.Y.Z version; no floating tag to move"
  exit 0
fi
major="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
if ((major < 1)); then
  echo "$version is before 1.0.0; no floating tag to move"
  exit 0
fi
tag="v$major"

current=$(git ls-remote --tags "$remote" "refs/tags/$tag" | awk 'NR == 1 { print $1 }')
if [[ "$current" == "$commit" ]]; then
  echo "$tag already points at $commit"
  exit 0
fi
if [[ -n "$current" ]]; then
  # A recovery run of an older release must not drag the tag backwards.
  git fetch --quiet "$remote" "refs/tags/$tag:refs/tags/$tag" --force
  if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor "$current" "$commit"; then
    echo "$tag points at $current, which is not an ancestor of $commit; leaving it"
    exit 0
  fi
fi

git tag --force "$tag" "$commit"
git push --force "$remote" "refs/tags/$tag"
echo "$tag now points at $commit ($package $version)"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Moves the floating major tag (v1, v2, ...) to a release commit, for a stable release at or past 1.0.0.
# Run inside the release-source checkout, after the release succeeded, so `uses: ...@v1` follows the newest 1.x.
# Usage: move-floating-tag.sh <release-decision.json> <package> <commit> [remote]
set -euo pipefail

decision="${1:?usage: move-floating-tag.sh <release-decision.json> <package> <commit> [remote]}"
package="${2:?missing package}"
commit="${3:?missing commit}"
remote="${4:-origin}"

if [[ ! "$commit" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]; then
  echo "::error::commit must be exactly 40 lowercase hex characters"
  exit 1
fi

version=$(jq -r --arg package "$package" '[.entries[] | select(.package == $package) | .targetVersion][0] // empty' "$decision")
if [[ -z "$version" ]]; then
  echo "$package is not in this release; no floating tag to move"
  exit 0
fi
if [[ ! "$version" =~ ^([0-9]+)\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then
  echo "$version is not a stable X.Y.Z version; no floating tag to move"
  exit 0
fi
major="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
if ((major < 1)); then
  echo "$version is before 1.0.0; no floating tag to move"
  exit 0
fi
tag="v$major"

current=$(git ls-remote --tags "$remote" "refs/tags/$tag" | awk 'NR == 1 { print $1 }')
if [[ "$current" == "$commit" ]]; then
  echo "$tag already points at $commit"
  exit 0
fi
if [[ -n "$current" ]]; then
  # A recovery run of an older release must not drag the tag backwards.
  git fetch --quiet "$remote" "refs/tags/$tag:refs/tags/$tag" --force
  if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor "$current" "$commit"; then
    echo "$tag points at $current, which is not an ancestor of $commit; leaving it"
    exit 0
  fi
fi

git tag --force "$tag" "$commit"
git push --force "$remote" "refs/tags/$tag"
echo "$tag now points at $commit ($package $version)"

---
source: crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/init/tests.rs
expression: workflow
---
name: Release

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions: {}

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

jobs:
  version-pr:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions: {contents: write, pull-requests: write}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with: {fetch-depth: 0, persist-credentials: false}
      - uses: orin-dx/callisto/.github/actions/callisto-action@aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa # callisto@0.8.0
        with: {mode: version-pr, branch: main}
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}

  plan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions: {contents: read}
    outputs:
      release: ${{ steps.decision.outputs.release }}
      matrix: ${{ steps.matrix.outputs.matrix }}
      has_napi: ${{ steps.matrix.outputs.has_napi }}
      napi_dirs: ${{ steps.matrix.outputs.napi_dirs }}
      has_artifacts: ${{ steps.matrix.outputs.has_artifacts }}
      has_python: ${{ steps.matrix.outputs.has_python }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with: {fetch-depth: 0, persist-credentials: false}
      # Content precondition, not release detection: `release plan` requires this commit to write its decision.
      - name: Check for a release decision
        id: decision
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          release=false
          if git rev-parse --verify --quiet HEAD^ > /dev/null &&
            git diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-only --diff-filter=AM -r HEAD^ HEAD | grep -qxF .callisto/release-decision.json; then
            release=true
          fi
          echo "release=$release" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - if: steps.decision.outputs.release == 'true'
        uses: orin-dx/callisto/.github/actions/setup-callisto@aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa # callisto@0.8.0
        with: {version: callisto@0.8.0}
      - name: Plan the release
        if: steps.decision.outputs.release == 'true'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent"
          callisto release plan --from-release-commit "$GITHUB_SHA" --decision .callisto/release-decision.json \
            --orchestration-revision "$GITHUB_SHA" --artifact-repository "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
            --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent/release-intent.json"
      - name: Build the matrix from napi targets and artifact slots
        id: matrix
        if: steps.decision.outputs.release == 'true'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          intent="$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent/release-intent.json"
          report="$RUNNER_TEMP/matrix.json"
          # Only packages in the release intent: an unrelated addon adds no build and cannot fail the plan.
          {
            while IFS= read -r package; do
              callisto --format json matrix --package "$package"
            done < <(jq -r '[.operations[].id.package] | unique[]' "$intent")
          } | jq -s '{platformTargets: (map(.platformTargets) | add // {})}' > "$report"
          napi=$(jq -c '[.platformTargets[] | select(.kind=="napi") | .targets[] | {kind: "napi"} + .]' "$report")
          slots=$(jq -c --slurpfile report "$report" '[.artifactSlots[] as $slot
            | ([$report[0].platformTargets[] | select(.kind=="cargo") | .targets[]
                | select(.artifactName == $slot.assetName and .triple == $slot.platform)] | first
              // error("callisto matrix has no entry for artifact slot \($slot.assetName)"))
            | {kind: "cargo"} + .]' "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent/release-intent.json")
          {
            echo "matrix=$(jq -cn --argjson napi "$napi" --argjson slots "$slots" '$napi + $slots')"
            echo "has_napi=$(jq 'length > 0' <<< "$napi")"
            echo "napi_dirs=$(jq -c '[.[].packageDir] | unique' <<< "$napi")"
            echo "has_artifacts=$(jq 'length > 0' <<< "$slots")"
            echo "has_python=$(jq '[.operations[].id | select(.role.kind == "registryPublish" and (.package | startswith("pypi/")))] | length > 0' "$intent")"
          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - if: steps.decision.outputs.release == 'true'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: release-intent
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
          if-no-files-found: error

  build:
    needs: plan
    if: needs.plan.outputs.release == 'true' && needs.plan.outputs.matrix != '[]'
    strategy:
  execute:
    needs: [plan, build, build-python]
    # A skipped build blocks only when it had nothing to build.
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.plan.outputs.release == 'true' &&
      (needs.build.result == 'success' || (needs.build.result == 'skipped' && needs.plan.outputs.matrix == '[]')) &&
      (needs.build-python.result == 'success' || (needs.build-python.result == 'skipped' && needs.plan.outputs.has_python != 'true'))
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    concurrency: {group: callisto-release-execute, cancel-in-progress: false}
    permissions: {contents: write, id-token: write, attestations: read}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with: {fetch-depth: 0} # zizmor: ignore[artipacked] tag push needs persisted credentials
      - uses: orin-dx/callisto/.github/actions/setup-callisto@aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa # callisto@0.8.0
        with: {version: callisto@0.8.0}
      - name: Install twine
        if: needs.plan.outputs.has_python == 'true'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 -m venv "$RUNNER_TEMP/publish-venv"
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/publish-venv/bin/python" -m pip install --quiet twine==7.0.0
          echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/publish-venv/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
      # Downloads land under $RUNNER_TEMP: `release execute` requires a clean worktree.
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          name: release-intent
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
      - if: needs.plan.outputs.has_napi == 'true'
        uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          pattern: napi-*
          merge-multiple: true
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/napi-artifacts
      - name: Place napi artifacts
        if: needs.plan.outputs.has_napi == 'true'
        env:
          NAPI_DIRS: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.napi_dirs }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          jq -r '.[]' <<< "$NAPI_DIRS" | while IFS= read -r dir; do
            npx --yes --package @napi-rs/cli@3.10.4 napi artifacts --cwd "${dir:-.}" --output-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/napi-artifacts"
          done
      - if: needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts == 'true'
        uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          pattern: asset-*
          merge-multiple: true
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-assets
      - if: needs.plan.outputs.has_python == 'true'
        uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          name: python-dist
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-assets
      - name: Write the artifact manifest
        if: needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts == 'true' || needs.plan.outputs.has_python == 'true'
        env:
          HAS_PYTHON: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.has_python }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          args=(--intent "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent/release-intent.json" --artifact-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-assets"
            --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-manifest.json")
          if [[ "$HAS_PYTHON" == true ]]; then args+=(--seal-python); fi
          callisto release artifact-manifest "${args[@]}"
      - name: Execute the release
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          args=(--intent "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent/release-intent.json" --receipt "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-receipt.json"
            --orchestration-revision "$GITHUB_SHA")
          if [[ -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-manifest.json" ]]; then
            args+=(--artifact-manifest "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-manifest.json" --artifact-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-assets")
          fi
          callisto release execute "${args[@]}"
        env:
          CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN }}
          NPM_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
          NPM_CONFIG_PROVENANCE: "true"
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}

108:Both blocks share five override fields, parsed identically; `[[package]]` also accepts `previous-tag-templates`. `[[package]]`'s `match` is an exact ecosystem-qualified id: the package's own name in that ecosystem, which for a dual package can differ per ecosystem (first matching rule wins). `[[package-set]]`'s `match` is an ecosystem-qualified glob, compared with each package's name in that ecosystem, and can match many packages at once; a rule for several ecosystems is one rule per ecosystem; `[[package]]` always takes priority over `[[package-set]]` for a given package.
115:| `tag-template` | string | none | Git tag template, e.g. `"callisto@{version}"` |
116:| `previous-tag-templates` | array of strings | `[]` | `[[package]]` only (`[[package-set]]` rejects it). Earlier tag templates checked (in order) for this package's last release tag, only if `tag-template` finds none. They are matched by name only, so this is how a renamed package claims the tags it made under its old name |
125:tag-template = "callisto@{version}"

Default tags use the display id, so newly created tags become qualified after name promotion; historical bare tags use the ownership fallback described in [identity](architecture/identity.md). Canonical references alone do not repair the open rename/demotion failures.

# 12. Canonical distribution references and explicit release ownership

Status: Proposed

This proposal revises ADR 11's selector promotion when implemented. ADR 11 remains the current decision, including its default tag; it is not superseded by this documentation change.

## Context

The owner selected Rust/Cargo, npm/pnpm and Python/PyPI as the current scope, with architectural room for Go and .NET/NuGet. The system audit found that display promotion leaks into dependency rewrites, historical ownership and shared tag/forge ordering. Fresh Cargo/Maturin projects also fail because one package requires one grammar. The evidence is in `git show 07154021c:docs/projects/V1-FINDINGS.md`.

## Proposed decision

- Require canonical slash-qualified distribution references (`cargo/name`, `npm/@scope/name`, `pypi/name`) in `callisto.toml` (groups, package rules, product and artifact packages), in report and matrix keys, and in command-line arguments. Reject the colon form everywhere. A `pypi/` reference uses the declared name. Native normalization belongs to the ecosystem.
- Changesets and `pre.json` keep native package names and resolve them when read. A changeset entry names the owner package, not a distribution, and the files stay readable by `@changesets/cli` (ADR 1).
- Separate release ownership, distribution identity, authoritative version source and external effects. Reuse existing types and graphs; do not add a general plugin framework or opaque IDs without need.
- Release ownership is derived, not stored: the owner of a package's shared tag, forge release and announcement is its first release id by ecosystem priority Cargo, npm, PyPI. The intent digest seals it and `release execute` re-derives it, so no owner field or wire change is needed for the current scope.
- Keep ADR 11's default tag, `{display id}@{version}`, and never rename existing tags. A package takes only the tags its commit shows it made, and `previous-tag-templates` declares a rename.
- Keep native names and manifest context for dependency edits, inherited/derived versions and publisher arguments.
- Within Callisto's release-operation graph, shared external effects have one owner and wait for every required publication/output of that owner: selecting one distribution of a package releases all of them, a product's announcement waits for the tag of each package whose asset it carries, and a dependent waits only for the dependency's distribution in its own ecosystem. For current ecosystems, public announcement follows registry completion; a future Go source tag can itself be publication.
- Native package-manager lifecycle hooks retain package-owner-defined behavior and environment. Callisto does not inspect, rewrite, suppress or reject hooks; effects initiated by owner-defined hooks are outside Callisto's release-operation graph.
- Reruns observe every required effect, including unfinished work after tag creation and missing Python files. Keep ADR 2's committed roster and ADR 3's no-journal recovery.
- Co-located Cargo and Maturin, whose Python version is derived from Cargo, is after v1.

Channel and private-registry policies are not decided here and are not release gates.

## Options considered

- Keep collision-triggered bare/qualified identity everywhere: retains inference rules at every new consumer and lets unrelated workspace changes alter identity behavior.
- Canonicalize one package ID but retain one grammar and per-distribution completion: does not represent Maturin version authority or shared tag/forge effects.
- Introduce a universal graph/plugin/build system: exceeds the supported use cases and duplicates ecosystem tools.

## Consequences

Pre-v1 breaking references are allowed by the owner requirement, but historical releases and committed decisions still need explicit compatibility. Cargo/npm/Python outputs can share an owner without pretending their native versions or registry evidence are interchangeable. Go/NuGet remain design examples, not shipped adapters.

## Sources

- Owner scope and canonical-identity discussion, 2026-09-26; [REQ-DX-V1](../specs/REQ-DX-V1.md).
- [Scoped model and primary-source prior art](../architecture/polyglot-v1.md).
- System findings and verification limits: `git show 07154021c:docs/projects/V1-FINDINGS.md`.

docs/errors.md:220:| E180 | Remote refused a tag push: a GitHub App token cannot push a commit whose `.github/workflows/` differs from every branch tip | This happens when releasing a commit that is not a branch tip (for example, recovering an older release) with GITHUB_TOKEN, which cannot be granted the `workflows` scope. Push the tag, and every other tag of this release, as an annotated tag at the target with a non-App credential (a PAT or deploy key), then re-run the release. |
docs/releasing.md:98:## Recovering an older release
docs/releasing.md:122:Registry checks confirm version presence, not identical bytes or the npm dist-tag. A Python release is complete only when every built wheel and sdist is on the index; a partly uploaded one is finished by uploading the missing files, and a sealed build also compares each file's digest. See [publishing limits](publishing.md#current-python-support-limits).
docs/architecture/polyglot-v1.md:3:Status: partly implemented. Canonical references, derived release ownership, per-distribution publish ordering, registry-before-tag ordering, PyPI file-set completion, platform packages before their owner, the `publish-url` split and prerelease npm dist-tags are current behavior ([ADR 12](../adr/0012-canonical-distribution-release-ownership.md)). Co-located Cargo/Maturin version derivation, build-input relationships, authenticated private PyPI, npm dist-tag promotion and the Go and NuGet adapters are design only. Owner scope: Rust/Cargo, npm/pnpm and Python/PyPI now; leave room for Go and .NET/NuGet without implementing their publishers. Current contracts remain in [the specs](../specs/INDEX.md). Remaining work is in [the roadmap](../projects/ROAD-TO-V1.md).

content.content:
Callisto waits for a published version to appear before it announces anything: up to 6 minutes for npm and PyPI, 2 for Cargo. npm packages are published back to back and waited for together, so a release of many npm packages waits once, not once per package; Cargo and PyPI publishes are waited for as they are published. If the registry is slower it stops with E157; re-run the failed job once the version shows, or set `confirm-timeout` on the registry in `callisto.toml` (see [configuration](config.md#registries)) and keep the job's `timeout-minutes` above the total wait.

## Recovering an older release

Recovering a commit that is no longer a branch tip may require these manual actions:

**E180: the workflow can't push tags.** GitHub rejects a `GITHUB_TOKEN` tag push when the tagged commit's workflows differ from every branch tip. Push every tag of the release yourself (PAT or deploy key), then dispatch the release for that SHA:

```sh
SHA=<release-source sha>
git tag -a "<tag>" -m "Release <tag>" "$SHA"   # each tag of the release
git push origin "<tag>"
gh workflow run callisto-release.yml --ref main -f release_source_sha="$SHA"
```

**`ArtifactAssetDiffers`: rebuilt assets don't match.** Rebuilt tarballs aren't byte-identical. Delete the mismatched assets and dispatch again:

```sh
gh release delete-asset "<release tag>" "<asset>" --yes   # each mismatched asset
gh workflow run callisto-release.yml --ref main -f release_source_sha="$SHA"
```

## Publication checks

Callisto checks the registry, remote tag, and GitHub release before each effect. An exact match is adopted; a conflict or uncertain result stops the run. Check the receipt and providers before treating a release as complete.

Registry checks confirm version presence, not identical bytes or the npm dist-tag. A Python release is complete only when every built wheel and sdist is on the index; a partly uploaded one is finished by uploading the missing files, and a sealed build also compares each file's digest. See [publishing limits](publishing.md#current-python-support-limits).

GitHub Releases start as drafts. Assets upload before the release is made public.
